name: Egnyte
description: Egnyte's hosted server searches and reads files in your Egnyte domain with your access rights.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp-oauth.egnyte.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
